verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ቤሴሌእል ፡ ወኤሊያብ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ጠቢበ ፡ ልብ ፡ እለ ፡ ተውህበ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወአእምሮ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ከመ
                  ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ግብረ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Beseleel wrought, and Eliab and every one wise in understanding, to whom was given wisdom and knowledge, to understand to do all the works according to the holy offices, according to all things which the Lord appointed.

translations.lxx: And Beseleel wrought, and Eliab and every one wise in understanding, to whom was given wisdom and knowledge, to understand to do all the works according to the holy offices, according to all things which the Lord appointed.
translations.kjv: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
translations.ron: Şi Beţaleel, Oholiab şi toţi cei cu minte iscusită, cărora Domnul le dăduse înţelepciune şi pricepere, ca să ştie să facă tot felul de lucruri trebuitoare la locaşul cel sfânt, vor trebui să facă după cum poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε Βεσελεὴλ καὶ Ἐλιὰβ, καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς τῇ διανοὶᾳ, ᾧ ἐδόθη σοφία καὶ ἐπιστήμη ἐν αὑτοῖς, συνιέναι ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ἔργα, κατὰ τὰ ἅγια καθήκοντα, κατὰ πάντα ὅσα συνέταξε Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ወጸውዖሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለቤሴሌእል ፡ ወለኤሊያብ ፡ ወለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ እለ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አእምሮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሑሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ግብር ፡ ከመ
                  ፡ ይፈጽምዎ ።
verses.translation: And Moses called Beseleel and Eliab, and all that had wisdom, to whom God gave knowledge in their heart, and all who were freely willing to come forward to the works, to perform them.

translations.lxx: And Moses called Beseleel and Eliab, and all that had wisdom, to whom God gave knowledge in their heart, and all who were freely willing to come forward to the works, to perform them.
translations.kjv: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
translations.ron: Iar Moise a chemat pe Beţaleel, pe Oholiab şi pe toţi cei cu minte iscusită, cărora le dăduse Domnul iscusinţă şi pe toţi cei ce-i trăgea inima să vină la lucru de bună voie, ca să ajute la acestea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε Μωυσῆς Βεσελεὴλ καὶ Ἐλιὰβ, καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἔχοντας τὴν σοφίαν, ᾧ ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιστήμην ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἑκουσίως βουλομένους προσπορεύεσθαι πρὸς τὰ ἔργα, ὥστε συντελεῖν αὐτά.

verses.geez:
ወነሥ[ኡ] ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ መባአ ፡ ዘአብኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ምግባረ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡
                  ወእሙንቱ ፡ ይትወከፉ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ያመጽኡ ፡ ነግሀ ፡ ነግህ ።
verses.translation: And they received from Moses all the offerings, which the children of Israel brought for all the works of the sanctuary to do them; and they continued to receive the gifts brought, from those who brought them in the morning.

translations.lxx: And they received from Moses all the offerings, which the children of Israel brought for all the works of the sanctuary to do them; and they continued to receive the gifts brought, from those who brought them in the morning.
translations.kjv: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
translations.ron: Şi au luat ei de la Moise toate prinoasele, pe care le aduseseră fiii lui Israel pentru toate cele trebuincioase locaşului sfânt, ca să le lucreze. Atunci tot se mai aduceau încă la el daruri de bună voie în fiecare dimineaţă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβον παρὰ Μωσῆ πάντα τὰ ἀφαιρέματα, ἃ ἤνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ἁγίου ποιεῖν αὐτά· καὶ αὐτοὶ προσεδέχοντο ἔτι τὰ προσφερόμενα παρὰ τῶν φερόντων τὸ πρωΐ.

verses.geez: ወመጺኦሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጠቢባን ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በበ ፡ ምግባሪሁ ፡ ዘይገብር ፤
verses.translation: And there came all the wise men who wrought the works of the sanctuary, each according to his own work, which they wrought.

translations.lxx: And there came all the wise men who wrought the works of the sanctuary, each according to his own work, which they wrought.
translations.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
translations.ron: Deci toţi cei cu minte iscusită, care împlineau tot felul de lucrări la locaşul sfânt, au venit fiecare, de la lucru cu care se îndeletnicea,
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεγίνοντο πάντες οἱ σοφοὶ οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ἁγίου, ἕκαστος κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔργον, ὃ εἰργάζοντο αὐτοί.

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ መባእ ፡ ያበውእ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እምግብር ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትገበር ።
verses.translation: And one said to Moses, The people bring an abundance too great in proportion to all the works which the Lord has appointed them to do.

translations.lxx: And one said to Moses, The people bring an abundance too great in proportion to all the works which the Lord has appointed them to do.
translations.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
translations.ron: Şi ei au spus lui Moise, zicând: "Poporul aduce mult mai mult decât trebuie pentru lucrurile ce a poruncit Domnul să se facă".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε πρὸς Μωυσῆν, ὅτι πλῆθος φέρει ὁ λαὸς κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὅσα συνέταξε Κύριος ποιῆσαι.

verses.geez:
ወአዘዘ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወሰበከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ለዕድኒ ፡ ወለአንስትኒ ፡ እምይእዜ ፡ ኢይግበሩ ፡ መባአ ፡ ዘዐሥራት ፡
                  ዘመቅደስ ፡ ወተከልአ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እንከ ፡ አብኦ ።
verses.translation: And Moses commanded, and proclaimed in the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman any longer labour for the offerings of the sanctuary; and the people were restrained from bringing any more.

translations.lxx: And Moses commanded, and proclaimed in the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman any longer labour for the offerings of the sanctuary; and the people were restrained from bringing any more.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
translations.ron: Atunci a poruncit Moise şi s-a strigat în tabără, că nici bărbat, nici femeie să nu mai facă nimic pentru dăruit la locaşul sfânt. Şi a încetat poporul de a mai aduce.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέταξε Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἐκήρυξεν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ, λέγων, ἀνὴρ καὶ γυνὴ μηκέτι ἐργαζέσθωσαν εἰς τάς ἀπαρχὰς τοῦ ἁγίου· καὶ ἐκωλύθη ὁ λαὸς ἔτι προσφέρειν.

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ አከሎሙ ፡ ለምግባረ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ወተርፎሙ ።
verses.translation: And they had materials sufficient for making the furniture, and they left some besides.

translations.lxx: And they had materials sufficient for making the furniture, and they left some besides.
translations.kjv: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
translations.ron: Căci material adunat era destul pentru toate lucrurile ce trebuiau făcute, ba mai şi prisosea.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ ἔργα ἦν αὐτοῖς ἱκανὰ εἰς τὴν κατασκευὴν ποιῆσαι, καὶ προσκατέλιπον.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጠቢባን ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ አልባሲሆሙ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ዘይከውኖ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ለካህን ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ
                  ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And every wise one among those that wrought made the robes of the holy places, which belong to Aaron the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And every wise one among those that wrought made the robes of the holy places, which belong to Aaron the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
translations.ron: Atunci toţi cei cu minte iscusită, care se îndeletniceau cu facerea locaşului sfânt, au făcut pentru cort zece covoare de în răsucit şi de mătase violetă, stacojie şi vişinie; şi în ţesătura lor au făcut chipuri de heruvimi, alese cu iscusinţă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε πᾶς σοφὸς ἐν τοῖς ἐργαζομένοις τὰς στολὰς τῶν ἁγίων, αἵ εἰσιν Ἀαρὼν τῷ ἱερεῖ, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ዘላዕለ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ዘደረከኖ ፡ ወሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወለይ ፡ ፍቱል ፡ ወሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ።
verses.translation: And he made the ephod of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

translations.lxx: And he made the ephod of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.
translations.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
translations.ron: Lungimea unui covor era de douăzeci şi opt de coţi şi lăţimea unui covor era de patru coţi. Toate covoarele aveau aceeaşi măsură.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε τὴν ἐπωμίδα ἐκ χρυσίου, καὶ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου, καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης·

verses.geez:
ወሰጠቅዎ ፡ ለቈጽለ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወገብርዎ ፡ አፍታለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትፈተል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደረከኖ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ሕብረ ፡ ከብድ
                  ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ለይ ፡ ፍቱል ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ማእነም ።
verses.translation: And the plates were divided, the threads of gold, so as to interweave with the blue and purple, and with the spun scarlet, and the fine linen twined, they made it a woven work;

translations.lxx: And the plates were divided, the threads of gold, so as to interweave with the blue and purple, and with the spun scarlet, and the fine linen twined, they made it a woven work;
translations.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
translations.ron: Cinci covoare au fost prinse unul de altul şi celelalte cinci iar au fost prinse unul de altul; şi aşa s-au făcut două jumătăţi de acoperiş.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐτμήθη τὰ πέταλα τοῦ χρυσίου τρίχες, ὥστε συνυφάναι σὺν τῇ ὑακίνθῳ, καὶ τῇ πορφύρᾳ, καὶ σὺν τῷ κοκκίνῳ τῷ διανενησμένῳ, καὶ τῇ βύσσῳ τῇ κεκλωσμένῃ· ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ἐποίησαν αὐτό·

verses.geez: ወገብርዎ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ዘይወርድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ መታክፊሁ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ማእነም ፡ ዘበበይኑ ፡ ፅፉር ፤
verses.translation: shoulder-pieces joined from both sides, a work woven by mutual twisting of the parts into one another.

translations.lxx: shoulder-pieces joined from both sides, a work woven by mutual twisting of the parts into one another.
translations.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
translations.ron: Apoi au făcut cheotori de mătase violetă pe marginea covorului din marginea jumătăţii întâi de acoperiş, unde trebuia unită cu jumătatea a doua; de asemenea au făcut şi pe marginea jumătăţii a doua, unde aceasta trebuia unită cu cea dintâi;
translations.grk: ἐπωμίδας συνεχούσας ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν, ἔργον ὑφαντὸν εἰς ἄλληλα συμπεπλεγμένα καθʼ ἑαυτό.

verses.geez:
ወእንተ ፡ ባሕቲትሁ ፡ ገብርዎ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ በከመ ፡ ግብረቱ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወያክንት ፡ ወበሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወበለይ ፡
                  ፍቱል ፡ ወበሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: They made it of the same material according to the making of it, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined, as the Lord commanded Moses;

translations.lxx: They made it of the same material according to the making of it, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined, as the Lord commanded Moses;
translations.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
translations.ron: Cincizeci de cheotori au făcut la o jumătate de acoperământ şi cincizeci de cheotori au făcut la cealaltă şi cheotorile acestea erau unele în dreptul altora.
translations.grk: Ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησαν αὐτὸ κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ ποίησιν, ἐκ χρυσίου, καὶ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου, καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ·

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ እብነ ፡ ዘመረግድ ፡ ወአውደድዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወግሉፍ ፡ ከመ ፡ ግልፈተ ፡ ማኅተም ፡
                  በአስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: and they made the two emerald stones clasped together and set in gold, graven and cut after the cutting of a seal with the names of the children of Israel;

translations.lxx: and they made the two emerald stones clasped together and set in gold, graven and cut after the cutting of a seal with the names of the children of Israel;
translations.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
translations.ron: După aceea au făcut cincizeci de copci de aur şi cu copcile acestea au unit cele două jumătăţi de acoperiş una cu alta şi s-a făcut un acoperiş întreg al cortului.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀμφοτέρους τοὺς λίθους τῆς σμαράγδου συνπεπορπημένους καὶ περισεσιαλωμένους χρυσίῳ, γεγλυμμένους καὶ ἐκκεκολαμμένους ἐγκόλαμμα σφραγίδος ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ·

verses.geez:
ወወደይዎ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መታክፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ዕንቈ ፡ ዘተዝካሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በከመ ፡
                  አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: and he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, as stones of memorial of the children of Israel, as the Lord appointed Moses.

translations.lxx: and he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, as stones of memorial of the children of Israel, as the Lord appointed Moses.
translations.kjv: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
translations.ron: Apoi au făcut covoare de păr de capră pentru acoperit cortul peste cele de mai sus. Unsprezece covoare de acestea au făcut.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος, λίθους μνημοσύνου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ ግብረ ፡ ማእነም ፡ ዕሡቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ግብረተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ወበያክንት
                  ፡ ወበሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወለይ ፡ ፍቱል ፡ ወሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ።
verses.translation: And they made the oracle, a work woven with embroidery, according to the work of the ephod, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

translations.lxx: And they made the oracle, a work woven with embroidery, according to the work of the ephod, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.
translations.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
translations.ron: Lungimea unui covor era de treizeci de coti, iar lăţimea de patru coti; şi cele unsprezece covoare aveau toate aceeaşi măsură.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν λογεῖον, ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ποικιλίᾳ κατὰ τὸ ἔργον τῆς ἐπωμίδος, ἐκ χρυσίου, καὶ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου, καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης·

verses.geez: ርቡዕ ፡ ወውጡሕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ ባዕ ፡ አውዱ ፡ ወባዕ ፡ ወርዱ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ውጡሕ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: They made the oracle square and double, the length of a span, and the breadth of a span,—double.

translations.lxx: They made the oracle square and double, the length of a span, and the breadth of a span,—double.
translations.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
translations.ron: Şi au unit cinci covoare la un loc şi pe celelalte şase covoare iar le-au unit la un loc.
translations.grk: τετράγωνον διπλοῦν ἐπόησαν τὸ λογεῖον· σπιθαμῆς τὸ μῆκος, καὶ σπιθαμῆς τὸ εὖρος διπλοῦν.

verses.geez:
ወተአንመ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ አርባዕቱ ፡ ጾታ ፡ እንመተ ፡ ዘበዕንቍ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ ጾታ ፡ ዘበዕንቍ ፡ በሶም ፡ [ወ]ወራውሬ ፡
                  ወዘመረግድ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘአሐዱ ፡ ጾታ ።
verses.translation: And there was interwoven with it a woven work of four rows of stones, a series of stones, the first row, a sardius and topaz and emerald;

translations.lxx: And there was interwoven with it a woven work of four rows of stones, a series of stones, the first row, a sardius and topaz and emerald;
translations.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
translations.ron: Apoi au făcut cincizeci de cheotori pe marginea covorului celui din marginea unei jumătăţi, unde aceasta trebuia să se unească cu cealaltă jumătate, iar cincizeci de cheotori le-au făcut pe marginea covorului din marginea celeilalte jumătăţi, care trebuia să se unească cu cea dintâi.
translations.grk: Καὶ συνυφάνθη ἐν αὐτῷ ὕφασμα κατάλιθον τετράστιχον· στίχος λίθων, σάρδιον καὶ τοπάζιον καὶ σμάραγδος, ὁ στίχος ὁ εἷς·

verses.geez: ወዘካልእ ፡ ጾታ ፡ በቀይሕ ፡ ያክንት ፡ ወበጸሊም ፡ ያክንት ፡ ወበጥልም ።
verses.translation: and the second row, a carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;

translations.lxx: and the second row, a carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;
translations.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut cincizeci de copci de aramă ca să unească covoarele spre a se face un singur acoperiş de cort.
translations.grk: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ δεύτερος, ἄνθραξ καὶ σάπφειρος καὶ ἴασπις·

verses.geez: ወሣልስ ፡ ጾታ ፡ በሊጊር ፡ ወአካጤ ፡ ወከርከዴን ።
verses.translation: and the third row, a ligure and agate and amethyst;

translations.lxx: and the third row, a ligure and agate and amethyst;
translations.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
translations.ron: Apoi au mai făcut pentru cort un acoperiş de piei de berbec vopsite în roşu şi un acoperiş, pe deasupra, de piei vinete.
translations.grk: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τρίτος, λιγύριον καὶ ἀχάτης καὶ ἀμέθυστος·

verses.geez: ወራብዕ ፡ ጾታ ፡ በዕንቍ ፡ ዘሕብረ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወበብረሌ ፡ ወኦኒክዮን ፤ ወዕውድ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ወእሱር ፡ በወርቅ ።
verses.translation: and the fourth row a chrysolite and beryl and onyx set round about with gold, and fastened with gold.

translations.lxx: and the fourth row a chrysolite and beryl and onyx set round about with gold, and fastened with gold.
translations.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
translations.ron: După aceea au făcut pentru cort scânduri din lemn de salcâm de pus în picioare.
translations.grk: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τέταρτος, χρυσόλιθος καὶ βηρύλλιον καὶ ὀνύχιον περικεκυκλωμένα χρυσίῳ, καὶ συνδεδεμένα χρυσίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወውእቱ ፡ ዕንቍ ፡ በአስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ በበአስማቲሆሙ ፡ ወግሉፋት ፡ ከመ ፡ ግልፈተ
                  ፡ ማኅተም ፡ ለለአሐዱ ፡ በበስሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፲ወ፪አንጋድ ።
verses.translation: And the stones were twelve according to the names of the children of Israel, graven according to their names like seals, each according to his own name for the twelve tribes.

translations.lxx: And the stones were twelve according to the names of the children of Israel, graven according to their names like seals, each according to his own name for the twelve tribes.
translations.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
translations.ron: Fiecare scândură era lungă de zece coţi şi lată de un cot şi jumătate.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ λίθοι ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ δώδεκα, ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν ἐγγεγλυμμένα εἰς σφραγίδας, ἕκαστος ἐκ τοῦ ἑαυτοῦ ὀνόματος εἰς τὰς δώδεκα φυλάς.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ዘፈረ ፡ ዘልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ ፅፉ[ረ] ፡ ግብረተ ፡ ፍትሎ ፡ ወወርቅ ፡ ንጹሕ ።
verses.translation: And they made on the oracle turned wreaths, wreathen work, of pure gold,

translations.lxx: And they made on the oracle turned wreaths, wreathen work, of pure gold,
translations.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translations.ron: Fiecare scândură avea două cepuri, aşezate unul în dreptul celuilalt.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ τὸ λογεῖον κρωσσοὺς συμπεπλεγμένους, ἔργον ἐμπλοκίου, ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ከባበ ፡ ጥውዮ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ ሕለቃተ ፡ ወርቅ ።
verses.translation: and they made two golden circlets and two golden rings. And they put the two golden rings on both the upper corners of the oracle;

translations.lxx: and they made two golden circlets and two golden rings. And they put the two golden rings on both the upper corners of the oracle;
translations.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
translations.ron: Aşa au făcut toate scândurile cortului şi anume: douăzeci de scânduri pentru latura de miazăzi;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο ἀσπιδίσκας χρυσᾶς, καὶ δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς· καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τοὺς δύο δακτυλίους τοὺς χρυσοῦς ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρας τὰς ἀρχὰς τοῦ λογείου.

verses.geez: ወወደይዎ ፡ ለውእቶን ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ሕለቃተ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ጽነፊሁ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ።
verses.translation: and they put the golden wreaths on the rings on both sides of the oracle,

translations.lxx: and they put the golden wreaths on the rings on both sides of the oracle,
translations.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
translations.ron: Şi sub aceste douăzeci de scânduri au făcut patruzeci de postamente de argint, câte două postamente la fiecare scândură, pentru cele două cepuri ale ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὰ ἐμπλόκια ἐκ χρυσίου ἐπὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν τοῦ λογείου·

verses.geez:
ወወደይዎ ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ ፅፍሮ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ሕለቃት ፡ እምክልኤሆሙ ፡ ገበዋቱ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡
                  ሎግዮን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ማኅበርቱ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ፅፍሮ ።
verses.translation: and the two wreaths into the two couplings. And they put them on the two circlets, and they put them on the shoulders of the ephod opposite each other in front.

translations.lxx: and the two wreaths into the two couplings. And they put them on the two circlets, and they put them on the shoulders of the ephod opposite each other in front.
translations.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
translations.ron: Pentru latura a doua, dinspre miazănoapte, au făcut alte douăzeci de scânduri
translations.grk: καὶ εἰς τὰς δύο συμβολὰς τὰ δύο ἐμπλόκια. Καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὰς δύο ἀσπιδίσκας· καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἐξεναντίας κατὰ πρόσωπον.

verses.geez:
ወአንበርዎ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ከባበ ፡ ጥውዮ ፡ ወወደይዎ ፡ መንገለ ፡ መታክፉ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡
                  አንጻረ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ።
verses.translation: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two projections on the top of the oracle, and on the top of the hinder part of the ephod within.

translations.lxx: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two projections on the top of the oracle, and on the top of the hinder part of the ephod within.
translations.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translations.ron: Şi patruzeci de postamente de argint, câte două postamente de fiecare scândură, pentru cele două cepuri ale ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὰ δύο πτερύγια ἐπʼ ἄκρου τοῦ λογείου, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ὀπισθίου τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἔσωθεν·

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ሕለቃተ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፤
verses.translation: And they made two golden rings, and put them on both the shoulders of the ephod under it, in front by the coupling above the connexion of the ephod.

translations.lxx: And they made two golden rings, and put them on both the shoulders of the ephod under it, in front by the coupling above the connexion of the ephod.
translations.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
translations.ron: Iar pentru partea dindărăt a cortului, dinspre asfinţit, au făcut şase scânduri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρους τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος κάτωθεν αὐτοῦ, κατὰ πρόσωπον κατὰ τὴν συμβολὴν ἄνωθεν τῆς συνυφῆς τῆς ἐπωμίδος·

verses.geez:
ወአንበርዎ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ መታክፉ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ እምታሕቱ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ማኅበርቱ ፡
                  መልዕልተ ፡ እንመቱ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ።
verses.translation: And he fastened the oracle by the rings that were on it to the rings of the ephod, which were fastened with a string of blue, joined together with the woven work of the ephod; that the oracle should not be loosed from the ephod, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And he fastened the oracle by the rings that were on it to the rings of the ephod, which were fastened with a string of blue, joined together with the woven work of the ephod; that the oracle should not be loosed from the ephod, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
translations.ron: Au mai făcut două scânduri pentru unghiurile de la fundul cortului.
translations.grk: καὶ συνέσφιγξε τὸ λογεῖον ἀπὸ τῶν δακτυλίων τῶν ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους τῆς ἐπωμίδος, συνεχομένους ἐκ τῆς ὑακίνθου, συμπεπλεγμένους εἰς τὸ ὕφασμα τῆς ἐπωμίδος, ἵνα μὴ χαλᾶται τὸ λογεῖον ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπωμίδος, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወአስተአኀዞ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ በሕለቃት ፡ ዘላዕሌሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕለቃት ፡ ዘልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ወእኁዛን ፡
                  በያክንቶሙ ፡ ወፅፉራን ፡ በእንመት ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይንጦልል ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡
                  መትከፍት ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And they made the tunic under the ephod, woven work, all of blue.

translations.lxx: And they made the tunic under the ephod, woven work, all of blue.
translations.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
translations.ron: Acestea erau prinse jos şi sus prin câte un inel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸν ὑποδύτην ὑπὸ τὴν ἐπωμίδα, ἔργον ὑφαντὸν, ὅλον ὑακίνθινον·

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘስሙ ፡ ሂጶዲጤን ፡ መትሕተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ግብረ ፡ ማእነም ፡ ዘኵሉ ፡ በደረከኖ ፤
verses.translation: And the opening of the tunic in the midst woven closely together, the opening having a fringe round about, that it might not be rent.

translations.lxx: And the opening of the tunic in the midst woven closely together, the opening having a fringe round about, that it might not be rent.
translations.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
translations.ron: şi aşa, cu cele două scânduri de la cele două colţuri erau la partea dindărăt a cortului opt scânduri, iar postamente de argint şaisprezece, câte două postamente sub fiecare scândură.
translations.grk: τὸ δὲ περιστόμιον τοῦ ὑποδύτου ἐν τῷ μέσῳ διυφασμένον συμπλεκτὸν, ὤαν ἔχον κύκλῳ τὸ περιστόμιονν ἀδιάλυτον·

verses.geez: ወፋእሙ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሂጶዲጤን ፡ በመንገለ ፡ ማእከሉ ፡ እኑ[ም] ፡ በፅፍሮ ፡ ወበዐይን ፡ ዘዖዶ ፡ ወሩኬብ ።
verses.translation: And they made on the border of the tunic below pomegranates as of a flowering pomegranate tree, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

translations.lxx: And they made on the border of the tunic below pomegranates as of a flowering pomegranate tree, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.
translations.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
translations.ron: Apoi au făcut cinci pârghii din lemn de salcâm pentru scândurile de pe o latură a cortului,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κάτωθεν ὡς ἐξανθούσης ῥόας ῥοΐσκους, ἐξ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου, καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዘባኑ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሂጶዲጤን ፡ መትሕቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽጌ ፡ ሮማን ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትጸጊ ፡ በደረከኖ ፡
                  ወበሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወበለይ ፡ ፍቱል ፡ ወበሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ።
verses.translation: And they made golden bells, and put the bells on the border of the tunic round about between the pomegranates:

translations.lxx: And they made golden bells, and put the bells on the border of the tunic round about between the pomegranates:
translations.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
translations.ron: Şi cinci pârghii pentru scândurile de pe cealaltă latură;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν κώδωνας χρυσοῦς, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τοὺς κώδωνας ἐπὶ τὸ λῶμα τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ῥοΐσκων·

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ጸናጽለ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወወደይዎ ፡ ለጸናጽሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽነፊሁ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሂጶዲጤን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውዱ ፡
                  ማእከለ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ሮማን ፤
verses.translation: a golden bell and a pomegranate on the border of the tunic round about, for the ministration, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: a golden bell and a pomegranate on the border of the tunic round about, for the ministration, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
translations.ron: Iar pârghia din mijloc au făcut-o aşa, ca să treacă prin scânduri, de la un capăt la celălalt al peretelui.
translations.grk: κώδων χρυσοῦς καὶ ῥοΐσκος ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ, εἰς τὸ λειτουργεῖν, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ጸነጽለተ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ዐውዱ ፡ ወፍሬ ፡ ሮማን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽንፉ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሂጶዲጤን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውዱ ፡ በዘቦ ፡
                  ይገብሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And they made vestments of fine linen, a woven work, for Aaron and his sons,

translations.lxx: And they made vestments of fine linen, a woven work, for Aaron and his sons,
translations.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
translations.ron: Scândurile le-au îmbrăcat cu aur; inelele, prin care se vârau pârghiile, le-au făcut de aur şi tot cu aur au îmbrăcat şi pârghiile.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν χιτῶνας βυσσίνους, ἔργον ὑφαντὸν, Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ዐፅፍ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ግብረ ፡ ማእነም ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፤
verses.translation: and the tires of fine linen, and the mitre of fine linen, and the drawers of fine linen twined;

translations.lxx: and the tires of fine linen, and the mitre of fine linen, and the drawers of fine linen twined;
translations.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
translations.ron: După aceea au făcut o perdea de mătase violetă, stacojie şi vişinie şi de în răsucit şi pe ea au făcut chipuri de heruvimi cu iscusinţă alese, ca să o pună între sfânta şi sfânta sfintelor.
translations.grk: καὶ τὰς κιδάρεις ἐκ βύσσου, καὶ τὴν μίτραν ἐκ βύσσου, καὶ τὰ περισκελῆ ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης,

verses.geez: ወልብሰ ፡ ቂዳርስ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ወልብሰ ፡ ሚጥራ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ወልብሰ ፡ ቃስ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ክዑብ ፤
verses.translation: and their girdles of fine linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet spun, the work of an embroiderer, according as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: and their girdles of fine linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet spun, the work of an embroiderer, according as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
translations.ron: Pentru ea au făcut patru stâlpi, din lemn de salcâm, i-au îmbrăcat cu aur, le-au făcut cârlige de aur şi sub ei au turnat patru postamente de argint.
translations.grk: καὶ τὰς ζώνας αὐτῶν ἐκ βύσσου, καὶ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου, ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወቅናታቲሆሙ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ወዘደረከኖ ፡ ወዘሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ወዘለይ ፡ ፍቱል ፡ ወዕሡቅ ፡ ግብሩ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And they made the golden plate, a dedicated thing of the sanctuary, of pure gold; and he wrote upon it graven letters as of a seal, Holiness to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And they made the golden plate, a dedicated thing of the sanctuary, of pure gold; and he wrote upon it graven letters as of a seal, Holiness to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
translations.ron: Apoi la uşa cortului au făcut o perdea de mătase violetă, stacojie şi vişinie şi de în răsucit, cu alesături.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸ πέταλον τὸ χρυσοῦν, ἀφόρισμα τοῦ ἁγίου, χρυσίου καθαροῦ· καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ γράμματα ἐκτετυπωμένα, σφραγίδος, Ἁγίασμα Κυρίῳ·

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ቈጽለ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ፍሉጥ ፡ ለመቅደስ ፡ እምወርቅ ፡ ንጹሕ ።
verses.translation: And they put it on the border of blue, so that it should be on the mitre above, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And they put it on the border of blue, so that it should be on the mitre above, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
translations.ron: Pentru ea au făcut cinci stâlpi cu cârligele lor şi i-au îmbrăcat cu aur, turnând pentru ei cinci postamente de aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὸ λῶμα ὑακίνθινον, ὥστε ἐπικεῖσθαι ἐπὶ τὴν μίτραν ἄνωθεν, ὅν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ወመሰልዎ ፡ በማኅተ[ም] ፡ ቅድሳቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
ወወደዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ነፅፈ ፡ ዘደረከኖ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንበር ፡ መልዕልቶ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ ሚጥራ ።
